items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of Sondernutzungserlaubnis
items.quote: Er ist innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, an das Bezirksamt Musterwerder, Wasserturmweg 3, 22089 Hamburg zu richten, und zwar schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated and posted 19.11.2026 (Thursday) by a district office (Bezirksamt), a general authority, not a tax office, so the deemed-delivery day is the 4th calendar day after posting and does NOT move even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Day 1=20.11 (Fri), Day 2=21.11 (Sat), Day 3=22.11 (Sun), Day 4=23.11.2026 (Mon) => deemed delivered 23.11.2026. One-month Widerspruch period (§70 VwGO analog, §31 HmbVwVfG with §§187,188 BGB): the delivery day itself is not counted; the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a normal working day in Hamburg (not Sat/Sun/holiday), so no shift under §193 BGB/§31 Abs.3 HmbVwVfG is needed. Deadline for the Widerspruch to reach the Bezirksamt: 23.12.2026.
